uncited: It builds on the lookup table mechanisms described in [Lookup Table and Configuration](4978-lookup-table-and-configuration.md).
This doubles the voxel volume, reducing the number of voxels to traverse by half.
*   **Voxel Boundary**: When using larger voxels (e.g., 2x2 pixels), the sampling of vertex values must be consistent.
*   **Ambiguity Resolution**: The standard 15-case LUT fails for cases 46, 47, 98, 99, 210, 213, 214, 215.
The improved algorithm uses 24 cases to resolve these.
*   **Parameter $\alpha$**: Setting $\alpha$ outside $[0, 1]$ may lead to extrapolation artifacts.
